status: externally published prior art and preprint comparators only; none adopted into primitive Causal Step dynamics
notes: Ranking A/B/C denotes relevance to diagnosing proposed bare causal hypergraph, not scientific truth or proof of physical equivalence.
Every entry names an input assumption absent from the current primitive Causal Step toy model, which has no derived 3D/4D, matter, quantum Hilbert/entropy or canonical bulk/boundary partition.

Explicit negative results count as important, including stabilizer cone not wholly representable by hypergraph mincuts, topological-link entropy vector beyond cut hypergraphs and area-law truncation dependencies.
2026 Bowen Zhao preprint was substantially narrowed in revised v2; do not repeat v1's unconditional claim as a known theorem.

sources.title: The Quantum Entropy Cone of Hypergraphs
sources.authors: Ning Bao; Newton Cheng; Sergio Hernández-Cuenca; Vincent P. Su
sources.finding: Uses finite-rank weighted undirected hypergraphs and min-cut entropy vectors; matches stabilizer cone up to 4 parties; 4-edge GHZ vector is beyond ordinary holographic graph cone.
sources.requires: Weighted hyperedges, predeclared boundary parties, undirected cuts, interpretation as surrogate entropy, not causal rewrite rule.
sources.use: Definable higher-order cut observables and entropy-inequality null examples.

sources.title: A Gap Between the Hypergraph and Stabilizer Entropy Cones
sources.authors: Ning Bao; Newton Cheng; Sergio Hernández-Cuenca; Vincent Paul Su
sources.finding: Refutes full higher-party equality: exhibits entropy vectors of six-qubit stabilizer states ruled out by new inequalities for hypergraph cut vectors.
sources.requires: The preceding hypergraph/min-cut and stabilizer-entropy definitions.
sources.use: Exact negative representation tests; distinguish expressiveness from universality.

sources.title: Hypergraph min-cuts from quantum entropies
sources.authors: Michael Walter; Freek Witteveen
sources.finding: Every finite weighted hypergraph min-cut function can be approximated up to global scale by stabilizer-state entropies; hypergraph cone is contained in stabilizer cone, but equality fails by rank/party no-go.
sources.requires: Quantum Hilbert spaces, multipartite GHZ resources, tensor-network construction and growing bond dimension.
sources.use: Precise theorem separating abstract hypergraph cuts from realizable restricted quantum entropy patterns.

sources.title: Topological Link Models of Multipartite Entanglement
sources.authors: Ning Bao; Newton Cheng; Sergio Hernández-Cuenca; Vincent Paul Su
sources.finding: Topological links realize certain entropy vectors that cannot be realized by standard graph/hypergraph min-cut models.
sources.requires: Link or knot topology richer than mere abstract hyperedge incidence, extra topological realization assumptions.
sources.use: Representation-sufficiency challenge: test missing linking/braiding data before claiming hypergraphs capture every entanglement structure.

sources.title: On Recovering Continuum Topology from a Causal Set
sources.authors: Seth Major; David Rideout; Sumati Surya
sources.finding: Topology via thickened antichains and nerve complexes recovers homology of globally hyperbolic spacetimes in sufficiently dense faithfully embedded causets.
sources.requires: Locally finite partial order, suitable antichains, manifoldlike faithful embedding and a separation of scales.
sources.use: Candidate procedure for detecting topology from causal order without assuming it follows from any arbitrary hypergraph.

sources.title: Stable Homology as an Indicator of Manifoldlikeness in Causal Set Theory
sources.authors: Seth Major; David Rideout; Sumati Surya
sources.finding: Persistence of antichain-thickening homology across scales is a useful necessary, not sufficient, signal of manifoldlikeness in tested discretizations.
sources.requires: Specified order, antichain/nerve construction and fixed reference 2D/3D geometries for controls.
sources.use: Topological-persistence falsifiers, with random order, transitive-percolation and topology-change controls.

sources.title: Network Geometry with Flavor: From Complexity to Quantum Geometry
sources.authors: Ginestra Bianconi; Christoph Rahmede
sources.finding: Nonequilibrium growth of simplicial complexes at chosen dimension d, a generalized area law, quantum network-state encoding of ensembles and emergent network geometries.
sources.requires: Specified simplex dimension d, simplicial face closure, flavor and attachment dynamics, Markov updates.
sources.use: Comparative generalized area-law and structural growth tests, with d and closure treated as assumptions.

sources.title: Emergent Hyperbolic Network Geometry
sources.authors: Ginestra Bianconi; Christoph Rahmede
sources.finding: Hyperbolic-like geometry occurs in selected evolving simplicial complexes.
sources.requires: Specific simplicial-complex growth and embedding/comparison conventions.
sources.use: Null model for emergent large-scale graph geometry, not empirical proof of emergent spacetime.

sources.title: Holographic quantum error-correcting codes: toy models for the bulk/boundary correspondence
sources.authors: Fernando Pastawski; Beni Yoshida; Daniel Harlow; John Preskill
sources.finding: HaPPY perfect-tensor code has bulk logical operators reconstructible from redundant boundary regions and reproduces selected RT-like entropy relations.
sources.requires: Chosen tensors/Hilbert spaces, quantum entanglement and a selected bulk/boundary network with hyperbolic tessellation.
sources.use: Finite exact recoverability/erasure tests only after an explicit boundary and information encoding exist.

sources.title: Holographic duality from random tensor networks
sources.authors: Patrick Hayden; Sepehr Nezami; Xiao-Liang Qi; Nathaniel Thomas; Michael Walter; Zhao Yang
sources.finding: Large-bond-dimension random tensor networks reproduce RT-type boundary entropy and bulk-entanglement-wedge encoding in the model.
sources.requires: Hilbert states, selected weighted graph topology, independent tensor randomness and high bond dimension.
sources.use: Comparison of bulk-to-boundary coding efficiency versus naive graph cuts and random baselines.

sources.title: Holographic maps from quantum gravity states as tensor networks
sources.authors: Eugenia Colafranceschi; Goffredo Chirco; Daniele Oriti
sources.finding: Defines graph-state quantum geometric bulk/boundary maps and derives entanglement conditions for the maps to be isometries.
sources.requires: Spin/group quantum geometry, Hilbert representation, specified open graph with bulk/boundary partition.
sources.use: Clear mathematical interface for reconstruction without asserting the primitive graph is already a quantum spin network.

sources.title: The Holographic Entropy Cone
sources.authors: Ning Bao; Sepehr Nezami; Hirosi Ooguri; Bogdan Stoica; James Sully; Michael Walter
sources.finding: Holographic entropy vectors satisfy restrictive graph/min-cut constraints, including monogamy of mutual information, and form a polyhedral cone in the stated static setting.
sources.requires: Classical holographic bulk dual, boundary regions, RT minimal surfaces; ordinary graph cut encoding.
sources.use: Distinguish holography-specific conditions from general quantum and hypergraph entropies.

sources.title: Quantum graphity: A model of emergent locality
sources.authors: Tomasz Konopka; Fotini Markopoulou; Simone Severini
sources.finding: Graph dynamics with fixed number of vertices can have low-energy relatively local and low-dimensional phases; links to string-net gauge excitations.
sources.requires: Finite N graph, chosen Hamiltonian, energy and state/graph degrees of freedom.
sources.use: Compare rule-conditioned localization phase to purely combinatorial emergence; not as pregeometry baseline.

sources.title: String-net condensation: A physical mechanism for topological phases
sources.authors: Michael A. Levin; Xiao-Gang Wen
sources.finding: Selected quantum spin lattice/string-net models support emergent gauge bosons and fermionic excitations.
sources.requires: Quantum local Hilbert spaces, lattice/geometry, chosen Hamiltonian and higher-dimensional conditions.
sources.use: Defined benchmarks for protected excitations and interactions at a later stage; not derived particles in Causal Step.

sources.title: Quantum gravity and the standard model
sources.authors: Sundance O. Bilson-Thompson; Fotini Markopoulou; Lee Smolin
sources.finding: Braided framed-ribbon-network configurations in selected quantum-spacetime models map to first-generation fermion labels and form noiseless subsystems.
sources.requires: Ribbon graphs embedded in a three-dimensional manifold, topology/framing, quantum moves and identifications.
sources.use: Concrete account of candidate particle-stability via topological protection; strong 3D-assumption obstacle.

sources.title: Topological entanglement entropy meets holographic entropy inequalities
sources.authors: Joydeep Naskar; Sai Satyam Samal
sources.finding: Holographic entropy inequalities are satisfied by specified topologically ordered gapped 2D ground-state entropies, showing such inequalities are not unique evidence of bulk gravity.
sources.requires: Quantum ground-state entropies, gapped 2D topologically ordered phase.
sources.use: Falsification: entropy-inequality matching alone does not demonstrate emergent spacetime.

sources.title: The holographic multi-entropy cone
sources.authors: Xin-Xiang Ju; Yang Zhao
sources.finding: Extends holographic entropy cone with multi-entropy coordinates; exact multicontraction certificates and facets at n=3,4 including purifier.
sources.requires: Holographic states with already designated boundary parties and entropy/multi-entropy definitions.
sources.use: Precisely defined multi-party inequality constraints once meaningful subsystem entropy exists.

sources.title: Graph models for covariant holographic entropy I
sources.authors: Bowen Zhao
sources.finding: Conditional HRT-to-graph construction from causal structure of entanglement wedges, provided exposed regions exist; other nested configurations remain only partly addressed.
sources.requires: Lorentzian bulk/HRT surfaces, null generators, entanglement-wedge causality and exposed-region condition.
sources.use: Exploratory bridge of causal structure and holographic graph representation, not full unconditional equivalence.

sources.title: Entanglement Entropy of Causal Set de Sitter Horizons
sources.authors: Sumati Surya; Nomaan X; Yasaman K. Yazdi
sources.finding: For a conformally coupled scalar field on dS causets in d=2,4, raw Sorkin spacetime entropy follows volume-law behavior; area law requires spectral truncation.
sources.requires: Prechosen spacetime dimension/background, scalar field, Sorkin-Johnston state and truncation prescription.
sources.use: Critical null: apparent area laws may depend on chosen cutoff and presupposed continuum.

sources.title: On the horizon entropy of a causal set
sources.authors: Ludovico Machet; Jinzhao Wang
sources.kind: peer-reviewed classical and quantum gravity theory (preprint v2 matches accepted manuscript)
sources.finding: Horizon molecule area-law descriptions depend on hypersurface conditions; a naive null extension can give nonlocal divergences or departures from local area law.
sources.requires: Faithful sprinkling into an existing causal spacetime/horizon and surface family; chosen dimension.
sources.use: Negative control against uncritical inference of holographic area law from causal links.

sources.title: The holographic principle
sources.authors: Raphael Bousso
sources.kind: peer-reviewed review of covariant area bound
sources.finding: Reviews entropy bounds on light sheets and their gravitational/quantum rationale.
sources.requires: Lorentzian spacetime, surfaces, null expansions, entropy notions and gravitational setting.
sources.use: Later observational correspondence target only after causal space/geometry reconstruction.
